ns2:course.label: Premodern Chinese Drama
ns2:course.description: Survey of Chinese drama from the 12th century through the early 20th century. Students will read major works of Chinese drama in English translation, as well as works on stagecraft, performance styles, the social functions of drama and the social role of actors. Videotaped contemporary performances of traditional drama will be viewed. Same as CWL 416, and THEA 488. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
